verdict.rationale: Versioned APIs with a deprecation policy are a fair question for a SaaS code-hosting platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents API versioning or an API deprecation policy. The OpenAPI probe found no spec at any candidate path, and the generic "build custom integrations" marketing line is only adjacent, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
